title: Codify implementation gate evidence ownership
summary: Define loop gate evidence contracts that keep tests as evidence providers and publication under implementation.

goal.outcome: Loop gate evidence contracts make decision/planning/implementation ownership explicit, keep tests as evidence providers, and keep publication criteria under implementation.
acceptance: Source or policy contract exposes loop gate evidence ownership for decision, planning, and implementation without adding validation or publish loop roots.
Evidence reporting distinguishes tests and linters as evidence providers from loop gate criteria owners.
Implementation/publication criteria stay under implementation, including task-close and ship-ready compatibility behavior.
File-structure/source-contract checks enforce exactly three loop roots and no fourth validation/publish root.
TASK-specific tests cover loop-owned evidence contract shape, publication-under-implementation invariant, and no fourth loop/root.
non_goals: Do not physically migrate all gateway/checks/policy helpers unless needed for contract clarity.
Do not create src/validation or src/publish roots.
Do not change public tool schemas except compatibility-safe additions.
verification: targeted TASK-115 test for loop-owned gate evidence contracts

delta.desired: Loop-owned gate evidence contracts make the three-loop model explicit and keep publication under implementation.
delta.current: Gateway/test/publication compatibility surfaces can look like independent loops or source roots.
delta.closure: Closed when source-contract and gate tests enforce no fourth loop and tests remain evidence providers.
